_note: Favorite companies the daily scan reads first and gives a score bump (tier 1 = most wanted, 3 = least; see tier_bump in search.json). Add entries like {"name": "Acme", "tier": 1, "boards": ["greenhouse:acme"]}. boards lists known job-board IDs (greenhouse:<slug>, lever:<slug>, ashby:<slug>); when empty the scan guesses slugs from the name. Every other company comes from open-boards.json, so this list can stay empty.
